# Mashable

> Mashable is a global, multi-platform media and entertainment company covering technology, culture, entertainment, shopping, and digital life.

Mashable publishes news, explainers, reviews, buying guides, and deals across consumer tech, social media, streaming, gaming, science, and internet culture. Its coverage spans editorial verticals, product roundups, and interactive games.

## News & Editorial Sections
- [Tech](https://mashable.com/category/tech): Technology news and analysis covering gadgets, apps, platforms, AI, and digital trends.
- [Culture](https://mashable.com/category/culture): Stories on internet culture, social media, identity, and life online.
- [Entertainment](https://mashable.com/category/entertainment): Coverage of movies, TV, streaming, celebrities, and pop culture moments.
- [Science](https://mashable.com/category/science): Reporting on space, climate, health, and scientific discoveries.
- [Social Good](https://mashable.com/category/social-good): Articles focused on activism, accessibility, sustainability, and social impact.
- [Life](https://mashable.com/category/life): Lifestyle coverage including relationships, wellness, and everyday digital living.

## Shopping & Deals
- [Shopping](https://mashable.com/shopping): Product reviews, buying advice, gift guides, and expert-tested recommendations.
- [Deals](https://mashable.com/deals): Curated discounts on tech, home goods, subscriptions, and seasonal sales.
- [Amazon Deals](https://mashable.com/category/amazon-deals): Deal coverage focused on Amazon discounts across electronics and household products.
- [Best Products](https://mashable.com/category/best-products): Roundups and recommendations for top-rated products across major categories.
- [Gift Guides](https://mashable.com/category/gifts): Gift recommendations for holidays, occasions, and different recipient interests.

## Product Roundups & Buying Guides
- [Roundups](https://mashable.com/roundup): Central hub for Mashable's product comparison and best-of guides.
- [Best Laptops](https://mashable.com/roundup/best-laptops): Laptop recommendations comparing performance, portability, and value across leading models.
- [Best Robot Vacuums](https://mashable.com/roundup/best-robot-vacuums): Expert-tested robot vacuum picks for different homes, budgets, and cleaning needs.
- [Best Dating Apps](https://mashable.com/roundup/best-dating-apps): Comparison guide to major dating apps for different goals and preferences.
- [Best VPNs](https://mashable.com/roundup/best-vpn): VPN recommendations covering privacy, streaming, speed, and ease of use.
- [Best Kindles](https://mashable.com/roundup/best-kindles): Kindle model comparison for reading, note-taking, and portability.
- [Best Headphones](https://mashable.com/article/best-noise-cancelling-headphones): Tested guide to noise-cancelling headphones for travel, work, and everyday listening.

## Entertainment & Streaming
- [Streaming](https://mashable.com/category/streaming): News and recommendations for streaming services, releases, and viewing guides.
- [TV Shows](https://mashable.com/category/tv-shows): Coverage of television series, recaps, trailers, and release updates.
- [Movies](https://mashable.com/category/movies): Film news, reviews, trailers, and commentary on major releases.
- [Netflix](https://mashable.com/category/netflix): Netflix-focused news, recommendations, and release coverage.
- [HBO Max](https://mashable.com/category/hbo-max): Articles about Max programming, premieres, and streaming developments.
- [Disney+](https://mashable.com/category/disney-plus): Coverage of Disney+ originals, franchise releases, and platform news.

## Tech Platforms & Digital Culture
- [AI](https://mashable.com/category/ai): Reporting on artificial intelligence tools, companies, ethics, and product launches.
- [Apple](https://mashable.com/category/apple): News and analysis on Apple devices, software, and ecosystem updates.
- [Google](https://mashable.com/category/google): Coverage of Google products, search, Android, and company announcements.
- [Microsoft](https://mashable.com/category/microsoft): Reporting on Windows, Surface, Xbox, and Microsoft services.
- [TikTok](https://mashable.com/category/tiktok): News and features about TikTok trends, creators, and platform changes.
- [Instagram](https://mashable.com/category/instagram): Coverage of Instagram features, creator tools, and social media culture.

## Gaming
- [Gaming](https://mashable.com/category/gaming): Video game news, releases, platform updates, and gaming culture coverage.
- [Nintendo](https://mashable.com/category/nintendo): News and features on Nintendo hardware, games, and announcements.
- [PlayStation](https://mashable.com/category/playstation): Coverage of PlayStation consoles, exclusives, and gaming updates.
- [Xbox](https://mashable.com/category/xbox): News and analysis on Xbox hardware, Game Pass, and releases.
- [Wordle](https://mashable.com/category/wordle): Daily Wordle hints, answers, and puzzle-related coverage.
- [Connections](https://mashable.com/category/connections): Daily hints and answers for the New York Times Connections puzzle.

## Science & Space
- [Space](https://mashable.com/category/space): Coverage of NASA, SpaceX, astronomy, and space exploration news.
- [Climate Change](https://mashable.com/category/climate-change): Reporting on climate science, policy, and environmental impacts.
- [Health](https://mashable.com/category/health): Health-related science and wellness stories with a digital-life angle.
- [Animals](https://mashable.com/category/animals): Science and nature stories featuring wildlife and animal behavior.
- [Environment](https://mashable.com/category/environment): Articles on conservation, sustainability, and environmental developments.

## Video & Interactive
- [Video](https://mashable.com/video): Mashable's video hub for interviews, explainers, and original segments.
- [Games](https://games.mashable.com): Playable games portal featuring crosswords, Sudoku, Mahjong, and casual puzzles.
- [Crossword](https://games.mashable.com/en-us/crossword): Daily crossword puzzle playable in the Mashable games hub.
- [Sudoku](https://games.mashable.com/en-us/sudoku): Browser-based Sudoku puzzle with multiple difficulty levels.
- [Mahjong](https://games.mashable.com/en-us/mahjong): Online Mahjong game available through Mashable's puzzle portal.
